verdict.rationale: Vanta's GRC page says you can cross-map controls across its pre-built (or customized) frameworks and automate across multiple frameworks without extra effort. The PCI page says controls are reused when adding new frameworks, and SOC 2, ISO 27001 and HIPAA are all listed as supported frameworks. The evidence is marketing copy only, with no detail on how SOC 2 evidence automatically satisfies the corresponding ISO 27001 and HIPAA requirements. Missing for 10: documentation of a view showing the overlap or mapping between frameworks, specifics of how evidence carries over from SOC 2 to ISO 27001 and HIPAA, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
